headline: RBI reassigns Lead Bank responsibility after Delhi district re-organisation
summary_points: Delhi Government's re-organisation created three new districts: Old Delhi, Central North and Outer North; Shahdara district has ceased to exist.
Lead Bank responsibility assigned for the new districts, and changed for Central and Northwest districts.
Bank of Baroda's Lead Bank responsibility for Shahdara (code 369) stands revoked; other districts remain unchanged till further communication.
who_is_affected: Lead banks concerned in the NCT of Delhi (Canara Bank, SBI, PNB, Union Bank of India, Bank of Baroda) and the State Level Bankers' Committee for Delhi.
action_required: Affected banks should take over or hand over Lead Bank responsibilities for the districts as notified and update district working codes in their records and reporting.

social.linkedin:
RBI has issued a circular (RBI/2026-27/300) on Lead Bank responsibility following the Delhi Government's re-organisation of districts in the NCT of Delhi.

The Delhi Government's Gazette Notification dated December 25, 2025 created three new districts: Old Delhi, Central North and Outer North. Shahdara district has ceased to exist.

Key changes:
- Old Delhi: Canara Bank (code 03E)
- Central North: State Bank of India (code 03F)
- Outer North: Punjab National Bank (code 03G)
- Central (358): Canara Bank to State Bank of India
- Northwest (362): Punjab National Bank to Union Bank of India
- Shahdara (369): Bank of Baroda's responsibility revoked

In all other districts, existing Lead Banks continue until further communication.

Banks, SLBC teams and financial inclusion and credit planning professionals should update their records and reporting accordingly.

Please verify the details with the official RBI circular before acting.
